name: How do I choose the right energy-efficient windows for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right energy-efficient windows for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right energy-efficient windows involves considering several factors: the window's U-factor, Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC), Visible Transmittance (VT), and air leakage ratings, which are typically found on the NFRC label. Lower U-factors mean better insulation, while SHGC should be chosen based on your climate – lower for hotter climates, higher for passive solar gain in colder ones. Consider frame material, glass type, and style to match your home's architecture and your budget. Consulting with a professional can help you select options best suited for your specific needs and the local climate in areas like Pacifica or Daly City.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose windows based on U-factor, SHGC, VT, and air leakage ratings, considering frame material, glass type, and style to match your home and climate.
